items.text: Thank you for your continued support and feedback for Moonlight Peaks. The major 1.3.9 update includes the following updates and improvements.
Moonshine, Mana Wine, and Juice (sell) prices have been increased to what they were before patch 1.2.3.
Participants of the Moonlight Ball now wear appropriate clothing.
Carried Vampsters now persist through cutscenes and dialogues.
Fish used as decoration can now be rotated.
Rabbiculas now only eat Carrots that have passed the seed stage.
The following spawns are now guaranteed after a fixed number of tries: Goliath, Pink Gulf, Sourbug, Sweetbug, Nokturna Cards.
Mandrake and Hold-Me-Close crops now only affect crops that are on the same ground level.
Daily conversations that unlock recipes will now show after reaching two hearts with an NPC.
Hearts in the relationship overview now do not sparkle while the available Heart Event is locked by external conditions.
Paintings received from Heart Events now all have a unique item preview.
Pumpkin Head Heart Events can now trigger during any day in autumn instead of requiring a full year to pass.
Kim's 1st Heart Event now ends after 2 minutes even if the player doesn't find the earrings.
Persephone's 2nd Heart Event now ends after 2 minutes even if the player doesn't find the bag.
The break-up option at Llemi is now worded as "Break up with...".
During the “A New Beginning” quest, a Fried Egg can now be given to Ludo anywhere.
When given at a different location than the Henderson's House, a new dialogue triggers and the quest objective is updated.
Loading a save file successfully now stores a backup. This is an additional safety measure that will restore progress if the current save file somehow becomes unloadable.
A notification is now shown when a backup save file is loaded instead of the most recent one.
The game version now displays in the Settings UI.
During the night-end sequence events are now announced as being "tonight" instead of "today".
Items in the cooking tab of the Almanac now only appear after unlocking their recipe.
Special crop mechanics are now explained at the seed shop and in the Almanac.
The relationship overview Nokturna status now has a distinct visual when the NPC doesn't want to play any more Nokturna that night.
Tooltips now properly display the correct button labels when using an Xbox or Playstation Dualsense controller.
Red and Pink Roses now spawn on Plot and Moonlit Pines during spring.
Moonlight Flowers now respawn at the Khazan Temple area during spring.
Glowing Mushrooms now spawn in the Cave of Echoes.
Pink Azeleas and Pink Tulips now spawn in the Pink Forest during spring.
Gramophone music now lowers in volume while background music is playing.
Gramophone music is now muted while a cutscene is playing.
Lowered the SFX volume of mining and breaking rocks.
Lowered the music volume of Gramaphones and reduced its range to match its effective range on trees.
Lowered the SFX volume of the train in the intro cinematic.
Lowered the SFX volume of waterfalls.
Lowered the SFX volume of item pickups.
Lowered the SFX volume of opening shipped crates.
Lowered the SFX volume of the Bat Nook interaction and added a SFX that plays while the player is inside.
Lowered the SFX volume of explosions during the “A Missing Moon” quest cutscenes.
Lowered the SFX volume of placing stamps during pottery.
Increased the SFX volume of shaping during pottery.

items.text: Thank you for your continued support and feedback for Moonlight Peaks. We've prepared the 1.2.7 update to address some performance and quest issues.
Fixed an issue where the “Elections by Moonlight” quest could not be continued. Players will have to redo the quest dialogue with the NPCs that are not crossed off in their quest objective.
Fixed an issue where upgrading the house caused an infinite loading screen when starting a new night if a Gramophone was positioned at certain spots.
Hey Moonlighters!

We heard your feedback on the price rebalancing in patch 1.2.3! While the changes were meant to make different ways of making money more viable, they ultimately made earning money more difficult and hurt anyone with a big vineyard.

It's clear we need to reassess our approach to updating the in-game economy for players at all stages. We'll keep considering the best approach, but in the meantime, we're fully restoring what you can earn from wine, beer, and honey. We also upgraded bulk cooking to be even more bulky!
Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us. Keep the feedback coming!
Restored recipes and prices of Red Wine, White Wine, and Beer to what they were before patch 1.2.3.
Increased Honey sell price and production to make it more profitable, matching the revenue from before patch 1.2.3.
Bulk cooking now works with up to 25 items instead of 8.
Bulk cooking now requires playing the cooking minigame only once per bulk.
Fixed an issue where some decorations could not be picked up anymore, including the Herb Garden and Cauldron.
Fixed an issue where additional copies of a Nokturna card were not recognized in the collection overview and deckbuilder.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback for Moonlight Peaks. The major 1.2.3 update includes the following updates and improvements.
The Museum now accepts higher quality items, including fish.
The red Gramophone is now always available for purchase at The Broken Lamp.
Bought accessories and other customizations are now stored in the player’s inventory and can be gifted and sold.
Hair can now be changed at the mirror instead of by consuming an Alter Ego Elixir.
Cooking can now be done in bulk, similar to crafting.
Cooking and crafting can now be canceled.
The amount of nights between some mainline quests have been reduced.
Plum and Willow trees now drop Dark Wood. Weeping Willow trees now drop Light Wood.
Forageables, including flowers, will now spawn even if low priority foliage is in the way.
Increased the respawn rate of foliage in non-plot areas, including trees.
Sugarbones now grow to full length everywhere and are only harvestable when fully grown.
Tier 2 spells can now be performed without the Witch’s Wand.
Antique Furniture decorations now have purple variants.
The HUD UI now displays the current day of the week.
The calendar as well as the end of night sequence now shows when it’s a full moon.
Added a separate accessibility tab in settings.
Added an accessibility option to increase the text size.
Added an accessibility option to reduce or turn off screen flash effects, including lightning flashes.
Improved the Quick Transfer tooltip to communicate the required input better.
The House Storage now shows more items per row.
Active quest items now display an icon and sort to the top of the list in the House Storage UI.
The Museum, Player House, and Henderson House now have a different map visual until they are repaired.
The log blocking the waterfall now shows on the map until it is removed.
Crops in the Almanac now show their Energy, Mana, and Mana Extract values.
Recipes in Kegs, Jam Makers, Mills, etc now show the energy and mana their products give when they are consumed.
During Nokturna deck building, cards now stay bright unless each owned copy is used in the deck.
While inspecting the board after a Nokturna match, the last round’s points are now still visible.
The Firefly Pollinator now shows a range indicator during decoration and while interacting with it.
The Firefly Pollinator now shows information about what it does while interacting with it.
The Firefly Pollinator's quality influence is now based on the amount of days it pollinates a crop and the amount of days it takes for the crop to fully grow.
An animal now complains about other animals in the same barn once every 7 nights.
Animal complaints about missing food or too much compost now have priority over complaints about other animals.
Items found from Lost Item job board quests are now not droppable and can be sold to Chester.
Mining bronze, iron, and gold ores now also drops stone.
Shaking trees now costs zero energy.
Firefly Pollinators now consume 1 Firedrop per night.
Firefly Pollinator range has been decreased from 9 to 8.
Reduced the price of items that take long passive times to produce, like wine.
Rebalanced the amount of Firedrops produced by Firefly Sanctuaries.
Rebalanced the amount of Honey produced by Bee Houses.
Rebalanced the spawn rates of animal produce and adjusted their sell prices accordingly.
Rebalanced the required resources for player house upgrades.
Rebalanced loot from shaking and cutting trees.
Rebalanced loot from dig spots.
Increased the pricing of the Purple Gramophone at The Howling Hammer.
The default stack size of items in the inventory is now 100. Pathways now have a stack size of 1000.
Slightly improved area loading times.

Fixed an issue where delayed NPC routine actions were not cleared when starting a new night.
Fixed an issue where the Cat Form would automatically walk back into the area it just came from.
Fixed an issue where custom item names did not show in the Chester UI.
Fixed an issue where the Light Chain decoration wasn’t lit.
Fixed an issue where the Rabbicula received from Saga had the portrait and texture of a Cowcula. This does not fix existing Rabbiculas.
Fixed an issue where the positional offset of hats when placed as a decoration was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where the Citrineflutter had an incorrect icon.
Fixed an issue where Brook was titled “Ghost Brook” in the Relationships tab.
Fixed an issue where Light Chain decorations bought at the Loveage festival were not lit.
Fixed an issue where the first Moonlight Ball after the Recover The Moon quest was always canceled.
Fixed an issue where Winston was missing for a few days after the Henderson House Warming.
Fixed an issue where the wrong spouse shows up at the dinner with the parents.
Fixed an issue where the player is able to sit on a chair that an NPC is already sitting on during Winterwake.
Fixed an issue where NPCs are trying to walk through Snek during Winterwake.
Fixed an issue where NPCs would use the Catacombs to travel before the Catacombs were unlocked.
Fixed an issue where the wedding of Kim and Samael could trigger during Moonlight Ball.
Fixed an issue where the progress bar in UI of farm objects like Beehouse only started filling when reaching the minimum threshold for producing 1 Honey per day.
Fixed an issue where the decorate input button shown in decoratable areas like Town Park kept showing while in Inventory and Pause UI.

topNew: The Museum now accepts higher quality items, including fish.
The red Gramophone is now always available for purchase at The Broken Lamp.
Bought accessories and other customizations are now stored in the player’s inventory and can be gifted and sold.

items.text: Thank you for your continued support and feedback for Moonlight Peaks. We've got another small update today that addresses some performance and quest issues.
Bug Fixes
Added a photo-sensitivity warning when the game first starts.
Fixed an issue where star signs of the Star Gazing minigame were obstructed by the black bars on wide screen monitors.
Fixed an issue where the Loveage Gift Exchange could soft lock the game.
Fixed animals in Luna’s shop becoming permanently unavailable after a heart event with Pumpkin Head.
Increased the chance of Weeping Willows respawning in the Howling Marshes to improve late-game access to dark wood.
Additional improvements are coming in 1.2.
Fixed an issue where the “Back to the Den” achievement did not trigger upon returning all Vampsters.
Players that have already returned all Vampsters will trigger the achievement in retrospect after advancing one in-game day.
Fixed an issue where the player could escape the Recover the Moon quest without finishing its objective.
Players that have experienced this issue and currently can't continue will automatically proceed to the next quest upon starting the next day.
Fixed memory leaks caused by the Bee House and Firefly Sanctuary.
Improved performance when using a mouse while having a lot of interactables.
Improved performance when having a lot of Farm Helpers (Furnace, Refiner, etc.).
Improved performance when picking up a lot of items at the same time.
Fixed various text issues.

We’re still continuing to investigate other previously known issues, and will provide more details on when those fixes come as soon as we’re able. Thank you for your patience as we continue improving life in Moonlight Peaks.
Fixed an issue where the embroidery table was not visible.
Fixed an issue where the game could not be loaded after upgrading the player’s house.
Fixed tree seeds not being plantable during all seasons.
Fixed tree seeds showing incorrect seasons in some places.
Fixed an issue where decorations on tables or shelves would not remove them from inventory.
Fixed an issue where crops did not grow during rainy nights.
Fixed an issue that caused save files to become corrupt by exiting the game during saving.

Thank you all for the support for Moonlight Peaks since launch. We’ve been thrilled with the response, and seeing all your farms and characters has been a delight. We’re actively taking in all your inquiries and working on implementing that feedback, and to that end, we have a significant update available for PC players today.

Included in today’s update are fixes surrounding stamina, storage, and some character interactions. We’re still investigating some of the other known issues. We’ll be providing more details on when those fixes come as soon as we’re able, but we appreciate your patience as we continue improving life in Moonlight Peaks.
Improved loading times for all scenes.
House Storage is now available from the entire plot, including barns and greenhouses.
Items can now be transferred from and to House Storage using Quick Transfer.
Embroidery now unlocks sooner.
This allows NPCs that go on Embroidery dates to be asked on a date sooner.
Tree seeds now show the seasons their produce grows, instead of the seasons the tree itself grows.
Added more Vampire Sketches from Brook.
Fixed the Net using energy on missed swings.
Fixed getting stuck in the Loveage Gift Exchange dialogue.
Fixed getting stuck after gifting Seaweed to anyone.
Fixed issue where beehives on plot caused performance issues when inside a building.
Fixed issue where Kim’s first Heart Event could cause time to pause until restarting.
Fixed issue where save files went missing. Those missing save files are restored.
This fix does not apply to save files becoming corrupt by closing the game while saving.
Fixed issue where some crops and trees did not grow to maturity.
Fixed not receiving a Nokturna card reward when exiting after inspecting the board on match end.
Fixed the Crow Introduction, Dead Crops, and Keg cutscenes causing other cutscenes on plot not to trigger.
E.g. Death handing over the Antique Clock and some NPC Heart Events.
Fixed issue where ingredients with no quality stay in inventory when crafting higher tier items.
Fixed issue where higher quality items placed in decorate mode would not be removed from inventory
Fixed Orlock being hard to interact with while sitting on a bench.
Fixed Moonlight Ball crowning ceremony taking too long to start.
Fixed Aras heart event showing sparkles on the tailor shop instead of town.
Fixed not being able to dig up Dig Spots near shore as Hellkitten.
Fixed issue where some NPCs stopped responding to gifts.
Fixed getting stuck when picking specific flowers in Pink Grove.
Fixed issue where upgrading the house can cause contents of Storage Crates to get lost.
Fixed issue where upgrading the house can cause decorations to lose their quality.
Fixed Steam Deck controls defaulting back to keyboard/mouse instead of controller.
Fixed issue that caused not being able to interact with anything on gamepad.
The underlying issue was that the cursor, hidden because the gamepad was targeted, was hovering over UI elements.
Fixed not being able to bind multiple actions to the same input.
Fixed short freezes every 5-20s
Fixed player getting stuck in slow walking animation when exiting doors
Fixed soft lock during the "new card" sequence while playing Nokturna
